verdicts.reason: A: a large white panel blocks the middle and hides the original's signature red/beige 'n' letterform. The top row of ART wordmarks is cut in half at the canvas edge, and the magenta/green/blue letter fragments on the right are cropped into an unrelated jumble, so it no longer reads as the same design. B: it keeps the left-side beige/red letter art and puts the quote on the right as in the original, so it is more faithful. It still has two flaws: the top ART wordmarks are sliced off at the top edge, and the coloured letter fragments are cut off where they meet the white text panel, which looks accidental and crowds the quote.
